exam: 110年專門職業及技術人員高等考試大地工程技師考試分階段考試（第一階段考試）、驗船師、引水人、第一次食品技師考試、高等暨普通考試消防設備人員考試、普通考試地政士、專責報關人員、保險代理人保險經紀人及保險公證人考試
subject: 關務英文

essays.text:
請將下列中文名詞譯為英文：（每小題 5 分，共 20 分）
①天然氣（天然瓦斯）
②合成纖維
③靠泊港（船舶於航程中停靠之港口）
④物聯網（英文縮寫為 IoT）

請將下列各題之英文譯為中文：（每小題 15 分，共 30 分）
①The commercial invoice is one of the most important documents ininternational trade and ocean freight shipping. It is a legal document issuedby the seller(exporter) to the buyer(importer) in an international transactionand serves as a contract and a proof of sale between the buyer and seller.Commercial invoices are often used by Customs to determine the true valueof goods when assessing duties.
②Non-intrusive inspection systems such as large-scale x-ray scanningequipment can give a quick insight into the cargo load of a container withoutthe need to open and unload it, thus confirming and clearing up the resultsof risk assessment. This can help to significantly reduce the number ofunnecessary physical examinations and to minimize the potential disruptionto the flow of legitimate shipments.

mcq.q: Customs authorities will not facilitate the flow of _______ travelers and trade practices.
_______ are essential to determine if goods are eligible for preferential tariffs or non-preferential tariffs.
Customs uses advance information submitted by carriers, freight forwarders or other relevant trade chainpartners to _______ high-risk shipments for examination.

Most trading countries, including Taiwan, the United States and India, use the Harmonized System (HS)as the basis of their classifications systems. The first _______ digits of HS codes are a common identifieracross all countries using the HS for that particular good.
A customs _______ is an official document that lists and gives details of goods that are being imported orexported.
If a qualified importer wants to import cosmetics containing medical or poisonous drugs, whichgovernment agency he needs to apply for a license?
The customs value of imported goods subject to ad valorem duties shall normally be determined andcalculated on the basis of the _______ value.

Free trade zone means a part of the territory of a Contracting Party where any goods introduced aregenerally regarded, insofar as import duties and taxes are concerned, as being _______ the Customsterritory.
Customs can give a notice for post-clearance audit within _______ months commencing from the datefollowing the release of the imports / exports.
The ATA Carnet is an international Customs document that permits duty-free and tax-free _______admission of most goods for up to one year.

All electronic Customs declaration and supporting documents pertaining to the importation / exportationshall be recorded for at least _______ years following the date on which the goods concerned are released.

Imported goods that are found to have been imported at a price less than the normal value of its likeproduct, thereby causing injury to any industry in Taiwan, may be subject to the imposition of _______duty in addition to the customs duty.
Customs _______ all mailing goods coming into Taiwan and examines more closely those that may posea threat to the safety of people.
Duties and taxes apply to all goods imported by mail that exceed the de minimis level of NT$ _______.
A large proportion of world trade is carried out by _______ enterprises.
If a trader disagrees with the classification number that is applied to his or her goods, the trader has theright to _______ it under the Customs Act.
Taiwan’s trade _______ system continues to provide robust protection to the domestic industries andworkers against the impacts of unfairly traded imports.
Authorized Economic Operators (AEOs) is a _______ public-private sector partnership program.
Customs may _______ articles suspected of bearing a counterfeit version of a trademark that is registeredwith the national competent authority.
_______ of paper documents reduces costs and time required for printing and transporting documentsbetween parties.
In determining the Customs value of imported goods, which of the following rules is NOT specified inthe Customs Act?
According to the Act for the Establishment and Management of Free Trade Zones, which of the followingactivities is NOT allowed within a free trade zone?
opts: Applying for authorization to use the monthly consolidated declaration
Applying for transporting duty-free goods out of the free trade zone for exhibition
Storage of industrial waste without prior approval of the competent authority
Transfer of merchandise from one zone to another

mcq.q: Which of the following statements, regarding bonded warehouse operations, is TRUE?
opts: The bonded warehouse can cease operations without prior approval from the Customs.
Customs may inspect the goods stored in the bonded warehouse when necessary.
The private bonded warehouses can be used for the storage of goods other than those owned by thewarehouse proprietors.
Bonded warehouse proprietors are not required to maintain inventory records of the merchandisereceived in the warehouse.

mcq.q: The country of origin of imported goods shall be determined by the _______.
opts: Bureau of Animal and Plant Health Inspection and Quarantine

mcq.q: Which of the following will not provide for revocation of a customs broker’s operating license?
opts: Applying for remote online declaration processing

mcq.q: According to the Customs Import Tariff of the Republic of China, the _______ of duty rates shall applyto goods imported from WTO members.
Which of the following is NOT valid security, guarantee or deposit as set forth in the Customs Act?
opts: Property with dispute over ownership rights
Time deposit certificates issued by a bank

mcq.q: Prior to importation, the duty-payer or the duty-payer’s agent may apply to Customs for _______ tariffclassification rulings of the goods and Customs shall reply in writing.
The implementation of tariff _______ allows a pre-determined quantity of a product to be imported atlower import duty rates than the duty rate normally available for that product.
Imported goods suspected of infringing Intellectual Property Rights may be _______ by Customs.

In the case where the import duty is not paid within the prescribed time limit, a _______ fee shall be leviedat the rate of 0.05 percent of the amount of duty per day beginning from the date following that on whichthe time limit for duty payment expires.
Customs clearance has been prioritized to facilitate the cross-border movement of _______ goods tominimize the overall impact of COVID-19 pandemic.

An economic operator with Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) status granted by Customs is entitledto more _______ than other economic operators in respect of customs controls, including fewer physicalor document-based controls.
The taxpayer of imported taxable tobacco and alcohol products shall declare and pay tobacco or alcoholtax as well as the health and welfare _______ to the Customs at the time of importation.
The Taxpayer Rights Protection Act has been implemented to insure rights of taxpayers, achieve tax_______, and carry through the due process of law.
Customs promotes the Real-Name _______ System to accelerate clearance of express consignments andsecure personal information.
African _______ fever is a severe viral disease affecting domestic and wild pigs. Travelers are remindednot to bring pork and pork products from those affected regions into Taiwan.
The duties or taxes paid on raw materials for manufacturing a commodity can be _______ upon the exportof that commodity.
If an offense subject to the imposition of a fine pursuant to the Customs Anti-smuggling Act is minor bynature, the fine may be reduced or _______.

When goods liable to ad valorem duty are imported into the Republic of China, the foreign currency pricesfor those goods shall be conversed into _______ using the exchange rates published regularly by theCustoms Administration.
